The restricted Windows cipher-object reader in db_windows.py adapts layout
constants and the extraction algorithm from fanyuantaier/wechatauto-replica,
commit d322c4a9b1124228820bab363e5676016f188fc6, wechatauto/db.py.
Source: https://github.com/fanyuantaier/wechatauto-replica
License: Apache License 2.0; see wechatauto-replica-LICENSE.txt.

Modifications: separate, bounded read-only process access; exact-version gate;
caller-supplied page authentication; volatile key buffers; no original package
initialization, UI manipulation, key files, or plaintext database caching.

SQLCipher and sqlcipher3 are separately installed optional dependencies, not
vendored here. Their packages retain their respective upstream licenses.
